history.title: History & Background
history.paragraph1: JakwirCode was founded in 2025 by three graduates of Universitas Harkat Negeri: Fadlian Yusuf as Founder, along with Mohammad Maulana Ikhsan and Faiz Ahnaf Maulana as Software Engineers. Inspired by the 'Jakwir' (close friend) philosophy from Tegal dialect, we built a culture centered on transparency and close collaboration.
history.paragraph2: Since its inception, JakwirCode has focused on providing integrated tech engineering solutions bridging web software development, mobile apps, IoT systems integration, and cloud architecture to drive digital business efficiency.

timeline.t1_desc: Established by three Universitas Harkat Negeri alumni (Fadlian Yusuf, Mohammad Maulana Ikhsan, and Faiz Ahnaf Maulana) focusing on software engineering, IoT, and web development.
timeline.t2_desc: Expanded portfolio into enterprise software solutions, cross-platform mobile apps, hardware sensor integration, and cloud architecture.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to JakwirCode. By accessing our website or utilizing our software engineering, IoT systems, and technology consulting services, you agree to be bound by the following Terms and Conditions.
terms.s1_p1: JakwirCode provides custom web software engineering, mobile applications, embedded IoT systems integration, and cloud infrastructure management based on written agreements (Proposal / Contract / Statement of Work) with the Client.
terms.s2_p1: Full copyright ownership of source code, UI designs, and documentation custom-built for the Client transfers to the Client upon full payment settlement.
terms.s2_p2: JakwirCode retains rights over core libraries, internal modules, and reusable components utilized during project execution.
terms.s3_p1: Payments are structured according to milestones agreed upon in the contract. Work commences upon receipt of the initial Down Payment.
terms.s3_p2: Delayed payments may result in project timeline adjustments or temporary service suspension.
terms.s4_p1: JakwirCode provides free bug/error fixing warranty for a specified duration (typically 30 to 90 days) following official project Handover.
terms.s4_p2: Warranty is void if failures stem from unauthorized third-party modifications, cyber attacks outside agreed scope, or client misuse.
terms.s5_p1: We are committed to maintaining strict confidentiality regarding all business information, sensor data, application logic, and trade secrets shared during or after the project period.
terms.s6_p1: JakwirCode shall not be liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or operational disruptions caused by events beyond reasonable control (Force Majeure) or third-party infrastructure failures.
terms.footer: Have questions regarding legalities & service terms?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: JakwirCode is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal data and business information of our website users and clients. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your data.
privacy.s1_p1: We collect information you provide directly when filling out contact forms, engaging in project consultations, or subscribing to our services. This includes your name, email address, phone/WhatsApp number, company name, and project requirements.
privacy.s1_p2: For IoT systems and web/mobile applications we engineer, sensor telemetry or activity log collection is strictly performed according to explicit permissions in service agreements.
privacy.s2_p1: Collected information is used solely to respond to consultation requests, provide proposals, execute project contracts, optimize application performance, and supply post-launch technical support.
privacy.s2_p2: We do not sell, rent, or distribute your personal or business data to third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.s3_p1: We implement industry-standard security measures, including data encryption in transit (SSL/TLS), role-based access control (Row Level Security / RLS on Supabase), and credential encryption to protect your system.
privacy.s4_p1: Our website may use essential cookies to store language preferences and session states for an optimal navigation experience. We do not use privacy-invasive third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.s5_p1: You have the right to request access to, correction, or deletion of your personal data stored in our systems at any time by contacting our privacy team.
privacy.s6_p1: JakwirCode reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Significant updates will be noted via the date modification on this page.
privacy.footer: Want to request data deletion or have privacy questions?
